intended_use: Benchmark salary estimation for tech roles in India based on role, experience, city, and skills.
prohibited_use: Guaranteed salary offer predictions, executive compensation forecasting, non-tech role extrapolation.
required_display_caveat: Estimated compensation range based on available market observations. Actual offers vary by employer, candidate skill depth, and negotiation.

intended_use: Benchmark base salary estimation for tech roles in USA across role families, seniority, city, and tech skills.
prohibited_use: Total compensation (equity/bonus) estimation, exact contract offers, non-tech job extrapolation.
required_display_caveat: Base salary estimate derived from public job requisitions. Total compensation including equity, bonuses, and benefits is not modeled.

intended_use: Descriptive grouping of job profiles into 7 skill-affinity archetypes.
prohibited_use: Career suitability guarantees, predictive job match success scoring.
required_display_caveat: Archetypes reflect observed statistical clusters of skill co-occurrences in the labour market.

intended_use: Mapping free-form job titles to 12 canonical occupation categories.
prohibited_use: Probabilistic certainty claims without calibration disclaimers.
required_display_caveat: Standardized canonical mapping. Non-standard or cross-disciplinary titles route to 'Other / Unmapped' review.

intended_use: Pairwise reconciliation of employer records against statutory registries within sovereign markets.
prohibited_use: Cross-market automated parent-subsidiary collapsing; 100% certainty claims on uncurated internet domains.
required_display_caveat: Matches verified against statutory corporate registries. Cross-border domain overlaps are routed to corporate hierarchy review.

intended_use: Extraction of technical skills from active job requisitions.
prohibited_use: Enterprise-wide staff competence assessment; uncalibrated single-letter token extraction.
required_display_caveat: Skill frequencies reflect specifications in verified job postings (Sample size N displayed); does not represent staff competency inventory.

intended_use: Displaying statutory workforce headcounts, historical size bands, and authorized vacancy volumes.
prohibited_use: Predictive future headcount forecasting; UK vacancy flow publication prior to licensing review.
required_display_caveat: Statutory headcount disclosures represent fiscal year-end establishment workforce. Open requisitions reflect advertised vacancy flow, not confirmed hires.
